extra_vocab.zh: 傑出的、特別好的；例外的
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇通知裡，exceptional reviews 是「極佳的評價」，指試用期間測試的員工給新系統很高的評分，用來說服大家放心使用。

example.en: This year's results were more exceptional than anyone on the team expected.
example.zh: 今年的成績比團隊中任何人預期的都更傑出。

example.en: She gave the most exceptional presentation of the entire sales conference.
example.zh: 她在整場業務會議中做了最傑出的簡報。

example.en: The new system is exceptionally easy to use for first-time employees.
example.zh: 新系統對第一次使用的員工來說格外容易上手。

example.en: Our suppliers are known for products of exceptional quality.
example.zh: 我們的供應商以品質特別優良的產品聞名。

example.en: The hotel was praised for its exceptional service.
example.zh: 這間飯店因傑出的服務而受到稱讚。

example.en: Refunds are given only under exceptional circumstances.
example.zh: 只有在特殊情況下才會退款。

example.en: She received a bonus for her exceptional performance this year.
example.zh: 她因今年的傑出表現獲得獎金。

example.en: All branches will use the new system with the exception of the Seoul office.
example.zh: 除了首爾辦公室之外，所有分公司都會使用新系統。

example.en: With very few exceptions, supply requests are approved on the same day.
example.zh: 幾乎無一例外，用品申請都會在當天核准。

examples.en: The team delivered exceptional results during the busy season.
examples.zh: 團隊在旺季交出了傑出的成績。

examples.en: Customers gave the new app exceptional feedback in the survey.
examples.zh: 顧客在問卷中給了新應用程式極佳的回饋。

confusable.diff: excessive 是「過多的、過度的」，字形有點像，但帶負面意味，不是「傑出」。

example.en: Excessive packaging increased our shipping costs this quarter.
example.zh: 過度的包裝使我們本季的運費增加。

similar.diff: outstanding 強調「突出、出眾」，常用於評價與表現；exceptional 另有「例外、特殊」的意思。

example.en: The outstanding sales results surprised the whole department.
example.zh: 出色的銷售成績讓整個部門都很驚訝。

similar.diff: excellent 是一般的「很棒」，口語常用；exceptional 比 excellent 更強調「超乎尋常」。

example.en: The restaurant has excellent food and friendly staff.
example.zh: 這家餐廳有很棒的食物和友善的員工。

example.en: We never compromise on the quality of our products.
example.zh: 我們對產品的品質絕不妥協。

example.en: The performance of the new system exceeded our expectations.
example.zh: 新系統的表現超出了我們的預期。

example.en: The product received a positive review in the magazine.
example.zh: 這項產品在雜誌上獲得正面評價。

example.en: We welcome your feedback on the trial version.
example.zh: 歡迎您對試用版提出回饋意見。

derived.link: except 是詞幹，「把…拿出來」；是 exception 與 exceptional 的基礎

example.en: The staff received exceptional training before the system launched.
example.zh: 員工在系統上線前接受了極為出色的訓練。

senses.en: not usual; happening only in special cases
senses.distinguish: 看到 circumstances、case、only 等字，多半是「例外的、特殊的」，不是讚美。

example.en: Late requests are accepted only in exceptional cases.
example.zh: 只有在特殊情況下才會接受逾期的申請。

extra_vocab.grammar_note: with the exception of 和 with very few exceptions 用的是名詞 exception（可數，常用複數 exceptions），不是形容詞 exceptional；with the exception of 後面接名詞，意思等於 except for。
